text: Stepping into this space, I am struck by the interplay between structure and fluidity—the sharp lines of glass, steel, and stark lighting outside transition into a world of vibrant color and words inside. The R+D wall beckons with promises of research and innovation, sparking curiosity about humanity’s evolving relationship with technology. Here, reflection thrives. I feel both the loneliness of observation and the thrill of inquiry—an outsider looking in, yet invited to think deeply among the artifacts of progress.
